notes.title: Ambidextro released
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445580/Ambidextro]Ambidextro[/url] is the latest game from Pineapple on pizza developers, available now on Steam.

Ambidextro is a 2D platformer game that challenges you to control two characters at the same time, one with each hand.

A witch has kidnapped the prince and the princess. As the royal wizard, you have been severed in half so you can go rescue both at the same time, but first you’ll need to learn to control the two halves of your body simultaneously.
Traverse 100 single-screen platforming levels and learn to control two characters at once. Achieve Ambidexterity and tackle increasingly challenging levels you would have thought impossible.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445580/Ambidextro]Check it out.[/url]

notes.title: Pineapple On Pizza asks an important question: can a video game convey flavour?
notes.content:
Indie studio Majorariatto have released small, experimental games every March since 2017 - barring the cursed year of 2020 - and now they’re back with another thought-provoking adventure called Pineapple On Pizza, this time asking the profound question: can video games convey such a complex flavour? It’s out now, it’s free, and it’s only about ten minutes long.
